infoLinks.urlText: Riverwood Station Lift 1 between Belmore Rd and Platform 1/2 is not available
infoLinks.content:
At Riverwood Station Lift 1 between Belmore Rd and Platform 1/2 is temporarily out of service.
From Sunday 12 October to Monday 15 December 2025, the lift will be closed for an upgrade.
Customers arriving on Platforms 1 and 2 that need lift access, will need to change at Narwee Station, then board the 940 bus to return to Riverwood Station.
Customers travelling from the concourse that require lift access, will need to catch the 940 bus to Narwee Station, then board a train to your destination.  
Baggage handlers will be available to assist during busy times.

If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 9563 7646.
